title: Write the #4174 reservoir placement as six ordinary width-H calls with a 6x interchange bill; cites #4942 for the branch threshold (no new κ)
body:
## Result

**Scoped counting proof, conditional on BIT.md's ordinary interchange as stated. No new κ.** The selected exponent stays 60403/20000000.

This answers open question 1 of pending #4938. Does one ordinary H-bit interchange of `research/unconditional-batched-crt/CRT.md` §3–§4 fit its bill `O(V H^{1-a} + V)` at the actual #4174 width `H = r_max G`? CRT.md's callee is BIT.md's machine. It exchanges two complete equal e-bit fields with arbitrary spectators in `O(V e^(1-a2))`, and its §4 wrapper falls back to elementary q-digit swaps (`q = 2^89 - 1`) at small widths.

**Relation to #4942.** James Reed's pending PR #4942 already evaluates BIT.md §4's wrapper branch at the reservoir width. It is elementary exactly for q-ary `E <= 311308` (binary `h < 27706412`), with `D = 19` and `k = 155654`. It gives `E = 121` at `H = 10752` and `E = 173` at `H = 15360`, and proves that every larger width is recursive. **Parts (iii)–(iv) below are an independent recomputation that agrees with #4942, which is their predecessor; no novelty is claimed for the threshold.** The new content here is **parts (i)–(ii)**: the write-up of the placement as ordinary calls, and the count of placement and restoration calls with the resulting 6x bill. Also new are the padding ranges (v) and a `D`-independent elementary bound.

For every layout the #4174 constructor accepts, `research/crt-reservoir-interchange-bill/PROOF.md` proves the following:

- **(i)** One `Plan.placement` (three sources to front `u`, front `t`, back `b`) is three ordinary calls of width exactly `H`, in any order. Restoration is the same three calls. That is **six calls per batch**, and every dirty record is restored.
- **(ii)** Given BIT.md's theorem, these cost at most `6 C_BIT V H^{1-a} + 6 c_own V`. This is CRT.md's bill with multiplicity 6.
- **(iii)** *(#4942, recomputed)* The wrapper runs at radix width `E = floor(H/89) + 1`. It is **elementary for every `H < 27,706,412`** and body at `H = 27,706,412` (`E = 311309`, `D = 19`, `k = 155654`). Since `H <= L/100`, every layout with `L < 2,770,641,200` runs all six calls, and all twelve §4 shuttles, on the elementary branch.
- **(iv)** *(agrees with #4942)* On that range `E <= H^{1-a}`, so the elementary stage alone meets the bill, with constant `C_0 q^2`. Also `H^a < 2^{1/20}`, so the `a2` saving is numerically absent.
- **(v)** The literal call pads the volume by `(q^E/2^H)^2`. This is in `(2^33, 2^34)` at the minimal layout and in `(2^73, 2^74)` at production.

Minimal layout: `p = 1310720`, `ell = 21`, `d = 2^16`, widths 20, so `H = 10752`. Then `E = 121`, `w = 2`, `D = 1`, `k = 8193` and `2k >= E`, so the branch is elementary. Production layout: `p = 9240576`, `ell = 24`, `H = 15360`. Then `E = 173`, `D = 2`, `k = 16385`, also elementary. These values agree with #4942. As an extra check of this package, any `D >= 1` keeps `H <= 1,458,353` elementary, so both layout results hold under any reading of `D`.

**Answer:** yes, the bill fits with multiplicity 6. At these widths the elementary fallback meets it, not the body word. The constant includes a real padding factor of up to `2^34` (minimal) or `2^74` (production) per call.

**Not proved:**
- BIT.md's theorem (used as stated; #4100 AUDIT.md records that its suites are not all passing).
- The stage-0 constant and the fixed-tape embedding cost.
- The rest of the §4 gadget.
- Any κ or frontier change.

## Task and overlap

Card `uniform-transfer-audit`, scope **refined** to the ordinary-callee bill of the #4174 placement. It continues the reservoir remainder of open question 2 in #4377 and #4650. Base: canonical main `cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703`, priority revision 7. Main was rechecked unchanged before submission.

Overlap: `scripts/find_overlap.py` (interchange/callee/placement/elementary terms; complete local inventory, 313 open PRs, 4015 discussion records) and open CRT PRs #4187, #4192, #4938. #4174 counts six width-`H` exchanges per batch and leaves the callee open.

**Crossed claims.** James Reed's CLAIM for #4942 ([comment 19136868](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19136868)) was posted one minute before this package's [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19136883). Both answer #4938's open question 1. #4942 delivers the wrapper-branch evaluation and lists the three-field placement as not covered. [James Reed's overlap note](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19136929) confirms that the placement write-up and call count were still open on that side. This PR therefore cites #4942 for (iii)–(iv) and contributes (i)–(ii) and (v).

The branch is based on main, not on #4938. #4938 is cited as a pending predecessor.

## Test plan

All of these pass:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-reservoir-interchange-bill --check-only   # PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-reservoir-interchange-bill          # normal and -O, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
python3.12 -O -B research/crt-reservoir-interchange-bill/verify.py                                    # PASS
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/crt-reservoir-interchange-bill/verify.py                           # PASS
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/crt-reservoir-interchange-bill --check-source-history  # PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_onboarding.py'               # 26 tests OK
```

`verify.py` takes about 8 s. It authenticates its four input pins and quoted phrases, and executes the authenticated #4174 allocator bytes. It checks:
- 12 exchange orders on dirty `Placement` fixtures.
- All 131,072 minimal plans (786,432 calls) and all 104,864 production plans.
- The exact bounds `1 - 2/q < |GL_64(F_q)|/q^4096 < 1` and the `j(D)` table.
- The wrapper branch at every `E <= 311309`.
- The radix lemma, `E <= H^{1-a}` and both padding ranges.

Its branch checks independently recompute #4942's values. The plan census, the six-call fixtures and the padding ranges are this package's own checks. It also runs 13 rejection controls. Separately, 10 source mutations of sharp claims were tested (`E_MIN`, `H_MIN`, the `j` table, the radix formula, the branch label, the call counts, the padding range, a dropped restoration call and the caller threshold). Each makes the verifier fail.

## Open next questions

1. Does a direct binary exchange of `H` single-bit swaps meet the same bill on fixed tapes without the `(q^E/2^H)^2` padding? First step: one bit swap as a single fixed-tape pass with a bounded buffer.
2. What is BIT.md's stage-0 constant `C_0` for one elementary q-digit swap? At every CRT layout with `L < 2.77e9` it is the whole callee constant. It is blocked because BIT.md does not detail the elementary algorithm.
